Please do not open a public issue for a security problem. Report it through
the private GitHub Security Advisory flow instead:

https://github.com/Anurup-R-Krishnan/OnlineFirPortal/security/advisories

Use this template only if you are unable to reach the advisory flow. Note that
filing this public issue already discloses the problem; prefer the advisory
flow whenever possible.

## What to include

- Affected endpoint or file and the version or commit.
- A minimal reproduction: exact request, environment, and steps.
- The impact you observed (confidentiality, integrity, availability).
- Suggested remediation, if you have one.

## What is out of scope

- Local, non-production credentials.
- Issues that assume already-compromised secrets.
- General hardening suggestions without a demonstrated impact.
